channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Canada
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: JF Candles Cozy Season Giveaway (candle gift set) – JF Candles (Maison JF)
item.description: Prize: Grand prize: a JF Discovery Trio gift set and one 10oz candle. Runner-up: two 4oz Maison JF candles. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Enter with your first name and email on the giveaway page (optionally follow @jf_candles on Instagram and tag two friends for one bonus entry). Oct 2 to Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 PM ET). Legal residents of Canada excl. Quebec, 18+. No purchase necessary; winners drawn Nov 1

item.title: Maritime Summers Fall Giveaway (sweater, hat and tote) – Maritime Summers
item.description: Prize: One MARITIMER sweater, one sailboat Skipper hat and one lobster tartan tote (approx. CA$250 retail value). Deadline: November 1, 2026. Follow @maritimesummers on Instagram and tag at least two different friends in the comments of the official giveaway post; sharing it to your Story with #contestentry gives one extra entry. Runs Oct 15 to Nov 1, 2026 (10 a.m. ET). Residents of Canada who have reached the age of majority

item.title: CARHA Hockey $2,000 Hockey Gear Makeover Contest – CARHA Hockey
item.description: Prize: Adult hockey equipment of your choice, bought by CARHA Hockey for the winner, up to a maximum of CA$2,000. Deadline: November 2, 2026. On Instagram, follow @carhahockey75, like the official giveaway post, and comment with the piece of hockey gear you would replace first while tagging a friend. Oct 15 to Nov 2, 2026 (11:59 p.m. ET). Legal residents of Canada excl. Quebec, 18+. No purchase necessary

item.title: Mondou Black Friday: 2 cartes-cadeaux de 500 $ – Mondou
item.description: Prize: 2 cartes-cadeaux Mondou de 500 $ chacune. Deadline: November 4, 2026. Participation en ligne avec nom, prénom et courriel; l'inscription à l'infolettre donne une participation de plus (2 maximum). Aucun achat requis. Majeurs résidant au Québec. Du 1er octobre au 4 novembre 2026, tirage le 5 novembre

item.title: Canadian Red Cross Holiday Contest: Air Canada flights, Honda mowers and more – Canadian Red Cross
item.description: Prize: 6 prizes worth about CA$13,552: 2 Air Canada economy return tickets plus 45,000 Wyndham points (about CA$9,650), 2 Honda lawn mower packages and 3 Keurig coffee bundles. Deadline: November 18, 2026. Fill in the contest form on the Red Cross site with name, email and phone. No purchase necessary; Canadian residents of age of majority, one entry per person (the travel prize needs a Wyndham Rewards membership). 12 Oct to 18 Nov 2026, draw 19 Nov; skill-testing question for winners

item.title: GothRider Badass Wake-Up Giveaway (coffee bundle worth $409.95) – GothRider (14746490 Canada Inc)
item.description: Prize: GothRider coffee bundle valued at CA$409.95. Deadline: November 18, 2026. Fill out the online entry form on the contest page between Oct 17 and Nov 18, 2026 (11:59 PM ET). One entry per person and email. Legal residents of Canada, 18+; winner must answer a skill-testing question. No purchase necessary. Live draw on TikTok Nov 19, 2026

item.title: Concours Carte-Cadeau VISA de 200 $ – Circulaire en ligne (Québec)
item.description: Prize: Une carte-cadeau VISA de 200 $. Deadline: December 20, 2026. Remplissez le formulaire de participation sur la page du concours. Gratuit, sans achat, résidents légaux du Québec majeurs; une participation par adresse courriel et par jour. Du 20 août au 20 décembre 2026; le gagnant doit répondre à une question d'habileté

item.title: Yokohama Canada Play Hard, Drive Safe Hockey Giveaway ($400 weekly) – Yokohama Tire (Canada) Inc.
item.description: Prize: 44 weekly prizes: a hockey gift card with approx. CA$400 retail value each. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Enter once per week by following the Instagram instructions on the giveaway page (follow, like and save the post; tag a friend or share for a bonus entry). Runs Mar 1 – Dec 31, 2026. Legal residents of Canada who have reached the age of majority; winners answer a skill-testing question. No purchase necessary

item.title: LICA Wear "La Marine" contest: gift cards worth CA$450 – LICA Wear
item.description: Prize: 5 LICA Wear gift cards: one of CA$250 and four of CA$50. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Fill out the registration form on the contest page with your details. No purchase necessary, residents of Canada aged 18+. Runs 29 Oct to 5 Nov 2026 (Eastern Time)

item.title: DUER Winter Outfit Giveaway (up to $500 CAD) – DUER
item.description: Prize: A DUER winter outfit (one bottom, tee, shirt and jacket) worth up to CA$500 at regular retail prices. Deadline: November 21, 2026. Opt in to DUER email offers with your email address on the giveaway page between Nov 1 and Nov 21, 2026 (Pacific Time). One entry per person. Legal residents of Canada (excl. Quebec) or the US, age of majority; Canadian winners answer a skill-testing question. No purchase necessary

item.title: The Roasters Pack Coffee Advent Calendar Contest – The Roasters Pack
item.description: Prize: Six winners drawn at random from the correct entries; the top prize includes the Complete Coffee Set Up Bundle ($500+ CAD value). Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free route: mail in a handwritten entry (name, address, phone, email and your guess for the country of origin of the Day 26 coffee), postmarked by Dec 31, 2026 and received by Jan 7, 2027. The purchase route is optional. Legal residents of Canada (excl. Quebec) and the US, age of majority; Canadian winners answer a skill-testing question. Contest period Dec 1 – 31, 2026

item.title: Tourism Whistler Go Bigger in Whistler Contest – Tourism Whistler
item.description: Prize: Winter trip for 2 to Whistler, BC: round-trip flights, 6 nights at The Westin Resort & Spa, 3-day Whistler Blackcomb lift tickets and rentals, Dawn Patrol heli-skiing, sightseeing tour, cultural centre and two dinners (approx. CA$14,000 / US$9,838). Travel Dec 2027–Mar 2028. Deadline: May 5, 2027. Register with name, email, phone and country on the contest page; one entry per person, plus one bonus entry for subscribing to the Whistler Insider newsletter. Open to residents of Canada (excl. Quebec), the US (excl. NY, FL, PR), Australia and the UK, age of majority. Closes May 5, 2027, 11:59 AM PST

item.title: Monos Mercedes-Benz G320 Giveaway (Canada) – Monos Travel USA Operations Ltd.
item.description: Prize: Restored 1998 Mercedes-Benz G320 Milspec Heritage G-Class, trip for two to Vancouver and a Monos luggage set (ARV US$97,500); US$20,000 cash option. Deadline: November 26, 2026. Complete the entry form at monos.com/giveaway. One registration entry per person; skill-testing question for Canadian winner. Canada (excl. Quebec), age of majority

item.title: Hillberg & Berk Oshawa Opening Gift Card Giveaway – Hillberg & Berk
item.description: Prize: $500 gift card to shop at Hillberg & Berk. Deadline: November 24, 2026. Complete the online entry submission. No purchase necessary; skill-testing question for the winner. Entries close 11:59 pm MST November 24, 2026, draw by November 25

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (CA) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: CA$1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time). Skill-testing question for Canadian winners

item.title: ACON Black Friday 2026 "Ultimate Backyard Setup" Giveaway (Canada) – ACON
item.description: Prize: ACON X 17ft trampoline + Soccer Goal Panel + Basketball Hoop with Back Net (worth CA$6,477). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on ACON's Canadian Black Friday page (joins the ACON VIP newsletter). Free. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 1:00 AM EST

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (CA) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV CA$999) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Canadian residents of the age of majority. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: Revelstoke Mountain Resort Winter Getaway Contest – Revelstoke Mountain Resort
item.description: Prize: Ski trip for 2: 3 nights at The Sutton Place Hotel, 3-day lift tickets, First Tracks, rentals and $100 Rockford gift card (over $3,500). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Enter via the form on the resort's contest page; one entry per person. Canada (excl. Quebec) and US (excl. FL, NY), age of majority. Trip Jan–Apr 2027. Closes Dec 1, 2026, 11:59pm

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: CST "Igniting Dreams" Contest: win a $10,000 RESP – CST Savings / CST Spark
item.description: Prize: $10,000 RESP grand prize plus monthly baby-gear prizes and $65 gift cards. Deadline: January 29, 2027. Fill in the online entry form (parent/guardian of a child under 13, or with their permission); bonus entries for referring friends. Canadian residents, age of majority. Closes Jan 29, 2027, 5 PM ET

item.title: Canadian Beef "Every Taste Tells a Story" Contest – Canada Beef
item.description: Prize: 10 × $200 CAD Visa gift card (one per monthly entry period). Deadline: March 31, 2027. Once per monthly period, enter via the contest post on @lovecdnbeef (Instagram), Canada Beef on Facebook or the Restaurant Gateway site; photo upload = bonus entry. Canada excl. Quebec, age of majority. Runs to Mar 31, 2027 (Dec 2026 = holiday season period)

item.title: Cashmere Collection 2026 voting contest – Kruger Products (Cashmere)
item.description: Prize: $5,000 CAD grand prize. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Vote for your favourite design and enter name and email at CashmereCollection.ca; 1 entry per day. Canada, age of majority

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: Matty Matheson x Get Cracking Contest – Egg Farmers of Canada
item.description: Prize: 10 prize packs (ARV min. $400 CAD each): MATHESON cast iron pan, co-branded merch and kitchen gear. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form at eggs.ca; 1 entry per person. Canada incl. Quebec, age of majority

item.title: Bathorium Presents: Soak in St. Lucia – Bathorium
item.description: Prize: Five nights for two at Sugar Beach, A Viceroy Resort in St. Lucia, plus $2,000 toward flights. Deadline: December 6, 2026. Enter free with your name and email (purchases, referrals and social actions add bonus entries but are not needed). Canada (excl. Quebec) and US, 18+

item.title: Canadel "Buying Local Pays Off" Contest – Canadel
item.description: Prize: 5 prizes by region; no-purchase entrants win a $4,000 Canadel gift certificate. Deadline: December 10, 2026. No-purchase entry: online form at canadel.com/BuyingLocalPaysOff/nopurchase, 1 per person. Canada incl. Quebec, age of majority; skill-testing question

item.title: Henry's Canon PowerShot V1 Email Subscription Giveaway – Henry's
item.description: Prize: Canon PowerShot V1 camera (ARV $1,249.99 CAD), one per quarter. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to Henry's email list and confirm; 1 entry per quarter. Canada excl. Quebec, age of majority

item.title: Transitions Canada Contest: GoldLeaf train trip for two – Transitions Canada
item.description: Prize: 3-day luxury rail trip for two (Vancouver–Jasper) with flights, ARV about $16,000. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the form at transitionscontest.ca (quiz, newsletter and colour pick give up to 3 extra chances). Canada, age of majority

item.title: Viking Q4 2026 "2027 8-Day Journey" Sweepstakes (Canada) – Viking River Cruises
item.description: Prize: 8-day Viking cruise of your choice for two including airfare (example values $24,396–$40,596 CAD). Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the entry form at vc-ca.com/sweepstakes; 1 entry per person. Canada excl. Quebec, 21+; skill-testing question

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
